description: Targets companies actively posting jobs for video editor / content manager / social media manager. These companies have budget, urgent need, and are already looking for what FASTECH does.

apify.budget_rule: Hard cap for ALL C1 Apify spend in one run (scrape + any Phase 3a email finding for C1 leads). Check APIFY_USERS_ME_LIMITS_GET monthlyUsageUsd before the first C1 call and after each call; stop C1 the moment (current - start) >= 1.00. Pass maxTotalChargeUsd on EVERY call.

banned_actors.curious_coder/linkedin-jobs-scraper: Ignores title/location input and returns generic listings (2026-10-02: 249 irrelevant jobs, ~$0.50 wasted). Never use.

sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs
sources.note: One-time setup: this actor needs 'full permission' approval in the Apify console (Actor page -> Approve permissions). Until approved it returns HTTP 403 — log it to #outreach-errors and continue with Indeed only.

input_per_call.title: <ONE exact title per call — the actor does not support OR queries>

strict_filters.title_must_match_regex: (?i)\b(video editor|video editing|youtube editor|reels editor|short[- ]form (video )?editor|content manager|content marketing manager|social media manager|head of social|video content creator|video producer)\b
strict_filters.dedupe_by: company name + job title (keep the newest)
strict_filters.rule: Drop every listing that fails ANY filter BEFORE enrichment. Never spend Firecrawl or email-finder credit on a listing that fails. Log the kept/dropped count per source.

email_angle: Reference the specific job posting. Position FASTECH as a faster, better alternative to hiring full-time. Emphasize speed (can start this week), cost savings vs full-time hire, and AI-powered output.
subject_line_examples: alternative to hiring a video editor in-house
saw your [platform] post for a video editor

extract_fields: any video content visible on site
